text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"revise","checked":["intent_match","tradeoff_direction","knob_legality"],"critique":"Intent “only alarm when it truly matters” aligns with minimizing false alarms, but proposed settings (transformer w7, threshold_q default, persistence 5) are not justified against the hard budget: at default persistence 1, false alarms are ~0.01/h; persistence 5 likely stays low, but the policy doesn’t ensure “truly matters” for unknown attacks.
